description.value: VanLove Sushi is a sushi and coffee restaurant on Robson Street near Stanley Park, founded by Ukrainian immigrants who bring a Ukrainian twist to sushi, mojitos, and desserts. The welcoming, owner-operated story sets it apart from typical sushi chains, and its patio and proximity to the Stanley Park cycling loop make it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the area.
